rows.notes: JSON body never arrives as a top-level array: rows sit under a data-carrying object key that is indexed per symbol -- daily/weekly/monthly bars at data['history']['day'] (:147), 1m/5m/15m at data['series']['data'] (:153) -- and each symbol gets its own request via asyncio.gather over split(',') (:169-171), with r['symbol']=symbol injected per row only when >1 symbol (:148-156). interval selects between /v1/markets/history and /v1/markets/timesales URLs (:123,132-142); intraday epoch timestamps are cast to NY-timezone datetimes and 'time' popped (:157-162); transform_data sorts on date/timestamp and applies a client-side date-window filter (:188-193).

No etf_historical.py exists: EtfHistorical is registered to the very same TradierEquityHistoricalFetcher (__init__.py:23), so every per-row fact of the EquityHistorical row applies verbatim -- rows must be indexed out of the per-symbol carrier keys data['history']['day'] / data['series']['data'] (equity_historical.py:147,153) with one request fanned out per comma-split symbol (:169-171), history-vs-timesales branch by interval (:123), epoch cast (:158-162), client-side sort and date filter (:188-193).

One GET /v1/markets/quotes?symbols=...&greeks=true (:236-238): unlike EquityHistorical there is no per-symbol fanout, all symbols ride one request, but rows still arrive under a data-carrying key, response['quotes']['quote'], which may be a bare single object for one symbol and is wrapped as [data] (:240-243). transform_data flattens the nested greeks dict per record (:273-277), rescales change_percent by /100 (:175-179), casts epoch-ms timestamps to NY datetimes (:146-173), nulls sentinel zeros (:181-189), and translates exchange codes via STOCK_EXCHANGES/OPTIONS_EXCHANGES (:257-271). UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: column_value_translation —— the exchange-code-to-name map rewrites values inside a column; field_rename_map (columns.rename) is the closest existing key but names key renaming, not value-domain translation.

is_symbol picks /v1/markets/lookup (plus types= param) vs /v1/markets/search (plus indexes=true) at :97-102 -- two different URL paths from one query flag. Rows are indexed out of the data-carrying key response['securities']['security'], a single security object is wrapped as [data] (:106-109). transform_data translates exchange codes via STOCK_EXCHANGES/OPTIONS_EXCHANGES by security type (:122-127). C93 resolved the two faces this row previously carried only as prose: the wrap is its own seam (single_object_array_wrap / shape.single_record_wrap) because resolve_rows refuses a dict and the row otherwise looks like a plain list of dicts -- path.object_keys names where records come from, not how many; and the exchange map is conditional_value_derive (derive.conditional), NOT the unmapped column_value_translation this row used to suggest, because the translated value is computed per record from a sibling field (d['exchange'] picked by whether d['type'] is option or index at :122-127), which is what derive.conditional already claims. The earlier suggestion is withdrawn here rather than left standing. One more face rides flow.branch and is recorded, not labelled separately: BASE_URL itself is chosen from the credentials sandbox flag before the branch (:84-92), and the two query additions at :100 and :102 are branch-scoped -- each extra parameter exists only on one side of the is_symbol split.

Three endpoint paths, chained: (1) /v1/markets/options/expirations preflight -- date list indexed out of response['expirations']['date'] (:139-150); (2) /v1/markets/options/chains fanned out as one request per expiration, rows indexed out of the data-carrying key chain['options']['option'] (:161-165,196-201); (3) /v1/markets/quotes via direct TradierEquityQuoteFetcher.fetch_data delegation, whose single underlying price is joined onto every chain row (:156-159,191-192). Per-row: greeks dict flattened, dead strikes with all-zero last/bid/ask dropped (:166-171), dte derived (:187-190); results sorted by [expiration_date, strike, symbol] (:205-207); transform_data returns the whole chain as parallel lists via DataFrame.to_dict(orient='list') (:263), with zero-nulling, ms-epoch casts, change_percentage/100 and exchange-code maps (:249-258). UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: column_value_translation —— the OPTIONS_EXCHANGES/STOCK_EXCHANGES value map at :238-246,256-257; field_rename_map is nearest but columns.rename covers key renaming, not value translation.
